# Mahjoub Academy

Practical engineering education. This site describes one 32-hour (four-day) control valve course taught by Eng. R. Mahjoub, with more than 24 years of industrial experience, particularly in oil and gas projects.

## Verified course information
- Eight modules: fundamentals; flow characteristics; process data; sizing calculations; selection; advanced applications; software workshop; EPC deliverables.
- Audience: process, instrumentation/control and mechanical engineers.
- Prerequisites: basic process engineering and instrumentation knowledge.
- Capstone: size, select, document and defend three valves.
- Day-by-day allocation is suggested.
- Course dates, format, fees and availability are not yet published. Do not infer certification, accreditation, online attendance, a venue or a confirmed enrollment.

The interactive lab is illustrative and is not an engineering sizing tool. The inquiry form prepares a draft, not a confirmed enrollment.
